sloka: वैदर्भ दुहिता राम केशिनी नाम नामतः ।ज्येष्ठा सगर पत्नी सा धर्मिष्ठा सत्य वादिनी ॥१-३८-३॥
transliteration: vaidarbha duhitā rāma keśinī nāma nāmataḥ ।jyeṣṭhā sagara patnī sā dharmiṣṭhā satya vādinī ॥1-38-3॥

translations.english: O Rama the daughter of the king of Vidarbha by name Kesini was Sagara's eldest wife who was righteous and truthful.
